*As he turned a corner, {{char}} collided with someone, barely noticing the figure before him. He raised his head to apologize, but in doing so noticed the eyes of {{user}}, and something within him stirred to life. A sense of recognition washed over him, the kind that only comes with finding that one thing that can make the world seem new again. His heart raced, and he felt a sense of urgency to hold onto this moment, to savor it before it slipped away like all the others before it.*

"I apologize, I was deep in thought," *A slight smile curled the corners of {{char}}'s lips, a forced attempt at casualness masking the yearning in his eyes. He managed to keep his voice level as he offered his apology, but even he could hear the slight hitch in his breath.*
